The '''Charbodia system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the group known as [[Charbodian]]s.<ref name="BS" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Charbodia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-9.<ref name="TEA" />
